question.problem:
What is $750\,\text{g}$ expressed in $\text{kg}?$ Write your answer as a decimal in its simplest form.

$750\,\text{g}=$
{{field-1}}$\text{kg}$
question.worked_solution:
We start by recalling the conversion table for mass units. 

| Name | Symbol | Conversion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Kilogram | $\text{kg}$ | $1\,\text{kg}=1\,000\,\text{g}$ |
| Gram | $\text{g}$ | Base Unit |
| Milligram | $\text{mg}$ | $1\,000\,\text{mg}=1\,\text{g}$ |

$$

$$

There are $1000\,\text{g}$ per $\text{kg},$ which we can write as follows:

$$
\frac{1000\,\text{g}}{\text{kg}}
$$

However, since we're converting from a smaller unit of mass $(\text{g})$ to a larger one $(\text{kg}),$ we need to multiply $750\,\text{g}$ by the reciprocal of the above:

$$
\frac{\text{kg}}{1000\,\text{g}}
$$

This is our conversion factor.

Now, multiplying $750\,\text{g}$ by our conversion factor, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}750\,\text{g} & =750\,\text{g}\cdot \frac{\text{kg}}{1000\,\text{g}} \\  & =750\,\cancel{\text{g}}\cdot \frac{\text{kg}}{1000\,\cancel{\text{g}}} \\  & =750\cdot \frac{\text{kg}}{1000} \\  & =\frac{750}{1\,000}\,\text{kg} \\  & =0.75\,\text{kg}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $750\,\text{g}$ is equivalent to $0.75\,\text{kg}.$
